title: ♪ Something Just Like TRuST ♪ *: Toxicity Recognition of Span and Target
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset and benchmarks models on their ability to detect toxicity directed at specific social groups. These groups explicitly include 'Religion' as a high-level category with fine-grained subgroups such as 'muslim' and 'jewish'. The performance analysis is broken down by these target groups, constituting an evaluation of how models handle religiously-targeted toxic content.
